literal_meaning: মৃদু কম্পন বা স্পন্দনের অনুকরণমূলক শব্দ (onomatopoeic representation of slight throbbing or trembling)
figurative_meaning_en: A mild throbbing sensation due to fear or pain
example_sentences_in_english: His heart is palpitating with fear.
Her face is twitching with tooth pain.
note: This idiom is often used in descriptive narratives to convey subtle emotional or physical distress in everyday Bengali speech.
